provenance.note: 'recorded' plans are the validated TurnPlan the real model returned for that question (before the server policy), copied from questions.plan. 'synthetic' plans are hand-written where the recorded plan did not follow the answer key's task; 'reason' says what the real model did. Plans that came from the rules fast path are not scripted (no model call). Extracted-attribute handles are replaced by their description when replayed (tests/acceptance/test_gate8_generality.py). Entries with 'recorded_with' were re-recorded after the TurnPlan gained value_filter and attribute.value_type (the earlier recorded or synthetic plan could not express a value condition); 'replaces' names the origin of the entry they replaced.
